response.text: {"label": "wrong_self_check", "reason": "The sub holds rxd low and then blocks on wait(!rx_busy), but the receiver keeps re-arming, so frame_error repeats every 380 cycles (sub `382 ... rx frame_error 1`, `762 ... rx frame_error 1`, ...) and no busy_fall ever occurs (unlike gold `79 795000 rx busy_fall 0`); the wait hangs, the run times out, and the A5 frame is never sent."}
